explainer_note: shap.DeepExplainer was tried first (per spec) and fails on this architecture: nn.LayerNorm inside nn.TransformerEncoderLayer is unsupported, raising an explicit additivity-check AssertionError. GradientExplainer has no per-layer op whitelist and works correctly on the same model.
